Number fuzzer on Enrollment/Founded/Year_Entered_Competition (REAL, scale 0): range [-1,1] floats — implausible for years/enrollment; FN source for range predicates like Founded > 1900.
Number fuzzer on Age (INT): values in {-2..2} — implausible ages; FN for Age >= 14 style filters.
String fuzzer on School/Location/Nickname/Player/Team/Class_A/Class_AA: random charset strings + contaminate; near-zero chance of matching real names — FN for equality/IN on these.

school_performance.School_Year (TEXT, 22 distinct 'YYYY-YY'): String fuzzer treats as generic text, not date — no format preservation; FN for LIKE '198%' or BETWEEN on year strings.

Composite PK (School_Id, School_Year): sample_fresh_primary_keys drops dupes on the pair; with collapsed School_Id and random School_Year, many rows survive — but School_Id FK ties to school's small set.
No NOT NULL/CHECK enforcement in Python: NULLs only from empty parent FK; otherwise all columns filled — original has 0 nulls, so NULL-handling predicates (IS NULL) will be FN.
Tiny original tables mean original_values (5 sampled) dominate String/Number element pools; p=0.2 fresh keeps many real values — good for equality, bad for range/aggregate diversity.
Number list-range quirk (upper end overwritten to full range) means even with real elements, fresh draws span [-1,1] — implausible numeric values dominate at larger sizes.
